title: Environment Sandbox lease, provider attempts, readiness, and cleanup
alt: Environment rechecks trusted Projects authority and selection around owner-fenced lifecycle changes. It records each provider attempt before an external effect and saves its exact outcome under the owner lock. Unknown or unresolved calls block release and generation advance. Late cleanup uses the active owner fence for authorization and keeps the saved source fence for provider identity; older-generation cleanup does not read or change the current Workspace. Claim expiry permits recovery but does not prove that a provider call stopped.
